posts.text: Studied over a period of nearly 200 years, tariffs in America 1) didn't raise the overall price level as much as some might guess but 2) did harm economic output, trade volumes, the global competitiveness of US goods, and -- contrary to their intent -- American manufacturing activity.
posts.summary: Tariffs harm economic output and US manufacturing competitiveness
